clips.title: The story
paras: In Sishir Canyon, Besseleth's Fang marks the end of a deadly spider's threat.

Besseleth and her brood make Sishir Canyon dangerous for travelers. At night, the giant spider turns the Webwinder Path into a death trap for those crossing the gorge. Her fang measures nearly two feet and drips with potent venom. Local defenders have suffered her venomous strikes, and presenting the fang brings them relief.
